# dejavu — OpenCode error-gate plugin

> Cross-session memory prosthesis with teeth for OpenCode: mechanically detects
> recurring tool-call failures and promotes them into enforced gates. Remind
> first, hard-block on same-session repeat offense. TypeScript + Bun, ships as
> source, no build step.

## What it does

Dejavu watches OpenCode tool calls (bash, read, edit, write, glob, grep) fail,
normalizes each call into a stable signature (paths/numbers/hashes/secrets
stripped), counts recurrences across sessions, and promotes a pattern into an
enforced gate after 3 failures across 2 distinct sessions. The next attempt at
a gated call is aborted with a REMINDER carrying the correction; retrying it
and failing again in the same session escalates to a hard BLOCK.

## Key properties

- Two scopes: project gates in `<repo>/.opencode/dejavu/gates.json` escalate
  to global `~/.config/opencode/dejavu/gates.json` after appearing in 2+
  project directories.
- Blocking policy: only non-diagnostic bash commands may block; file probes
  and diagnostics stay `watching` forever (`canBlock()` in src/patterns.ts).
- Secret scrubbing before any persistence (OpenAI/Anthropic/AWS/GitHub/Slack/
  Stripe/JWT/PEM/DB-conn patterns).
- Gates expire after 60 days without recurrence; `recurredAfterGate` is the
  health metric; `scripts/doctor.ts` reports all pathology classes.
- `DEJAVU_HOME` env var overrides the global store directory (testing,
  custom setups).
- Companion agent skill (skills/dejavu/SKILL.md) and `/dejavu` status command
  (command/dejavu.md).

## Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/WhiteBite/opencode-dejavu ~/.config/opencode/vendor/dejavu
```

```ts
// ~/.config/opencode/plugins/dejavu.ts
export { Dejavu } from "../vendor/dejavu/index.ts"
```

## Files

- [index.ts](./index.ts): plugin entry — `Dejavu` factory, 4 hooks
  (tool.execute.before/after, event, experimental.session.compacting)
- [src/patterns.ts](./src/patterns.ts): signature normalization, secret
  scrubbing, failure detection, blocking policy, fuzzy matching
- [src/store.ts](./src/store.ts): GateStore/Stores — two-scope persistence,
  lockfiles, promotion, TTL expiry, migration
- [test/smoke.ts](./test/smoke.ts): behavioral smoke test (`bun test/smoke.ts`)
- [scripts/doctor.ts](./scripts/doctor.ts): pathology report
- [scripts/analyze.ts](./scripts/analyze.ts): store summary
- [scripts/migrate.ts](./scripts/migrate.ts): demote + scrub migration
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): coding-agent context for this repository
- [skills/dejavu/SKILL.md](./skills/dejavu/SKILL.md): companion agent protocol
- [command/dejavu.md](./command/dejavu.md): /dejavu status command

## Commands

```bash
bun install
bun run typecheck        # tsc --noEmit
bun test/smoke.ts        # behavioral test suite
bun scripts/doctor.ts [projectDirs...]
```
